title: Fruit Bubble Pop
description: Bank crisp shots off side walls to pop vibrant clusters of glossy fruit bubbles—drop whole hanging sections at once for juicy cascade scores.
controls: Drag to aim the dotted bounce guide and release to shoot fruit bubbles into matching color clusters.

zh-CN.title: 水果泡泡龙
zh-CN.description: 经典全民休闲水果泡泡龙：拉线借助墙壁反弹精准射出彩色水果泡泡，打断顶部支点整片掉落爽翻天！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动虚线瞄准目标颜色泡泡，松手发射凑齐三个及以上同色消除。
